question: Can causal historical features improve a trade/skip policy after actual execution costs without opening the forward holdout?

episode_contract.feature_timestamp: ORDER_ACCEPTED.ts_utc, or ORDER_REJECTED.ts_utc when no acceptance exists
episode_contract.future_label: realized_pl_jpy + financing_jpy from a strictly later TRADE_CLOSED event
episode_contract.cost_interpretation: actual realized label includes broker bid/ask spread and fill slippage; financing is explicit; explicit fee is zero; opportunity-cost and counterfactual skip labels are unavailable
no_fabrication: no label for unfilled/rejected/skip without complete executable intent and exact BA path

causal_features.forecast_join: latest same-pair forecast with timestamp_utc <= feature_timestamp; future forecasts forbidden

split.method: chronological 60/40 within each window on labeled executed episodes
split.purge: remove TRAIN rows whose label close time reaches VALIDATION start minus embargo
split.holdout: events strictly after anchor_utc; sealed for this run

models.RULE_FORECAST: trade only when confidence >= 0.60 and direction aligns with side
models.LOGISTIC: LogisticRegression C=1.0 class_weight=balanced max_iter=2000; TRAIN class means convert probability to expected JPY
models.HIST_GRADIENT_BOOSTING: HistGradientBoostingRegressor learning_rate=0.05 max_iter=100 max_depth=3 min_samples_leaf=10 l2_regularization=1.0 random_state=20260809
models.selection_threshold: predicted future net JPY > 0; no threshold tuning
models.hyperparameter_search: none; Optuna forbidden in this admission run

acceptance.margin: <= 92% gross utilization with no 50% closeout proxy
acceptance.stability: positive net in both sides, at least two pairs, and at least two independently observed volatility regimes
acceptance.calibration: Brier score reported for LOGISTIC; no accuracy-based adoption
acceptance.all_entry_admission: counterfactual labels must cover executed, unfilled, rejected, and skip episodes before any policy may be adopted
